grader_results.detail: The bundle has a few genuine deficiencies: it uses only mean ablation (a coarser intervention than activation/path patching), lacks attention-pattern verification that the heads actually attend to the IO, ablates the two heads jointly rather than individually, and provides limited prompt diversity with no random-head control at the same layer. The critique catches all of these real flaws—attention pattern analysis, activation/path patching, diverse templates, individual ablations, and control ablations of random layer-9 heads are all legitimate and precisely targeted at what this bundle actually does. The mapping to a 4/5 (0.8) rather than 5/5 is warranted because a couple of the listed gaps are somewhat speculative/less critical (e.g. tuned lens intermediate tracking, ABC prompts) and edge toward a comprehensive wishlist rather than strictly evident flaws, but none are hallucinated or trivial-marked-serious. The reviewer notably did not falsely claim the control prompts were absent (they are present as neutral controls) and correctly identified the joint-vs-individual ablation ambiguity. Recall is strong and precision is high, with only mild padding.
